pilots.name: elements-50-our-table-v2
pilots.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. REDESIGN THE MATERIAL, not a texture filter. Reference 1 (garden) and reference 2 (simple food elements) are the ONLY material authorities: actual layered FLAT colored paper cutouts, clearly readable gently uneven scissor edges, quiet mostly smooth matte colored sheets with sparse subtle fibers. A few broad color shapes per object, short soft contact shadows immediately beneath overlapping edges, all in one consistent light direction. NO all-over noise, fine stippling, ripples, embossing, crumpled paper, repeated texture pattern, glossy shading, bevels, inflated 3D or photographic food. Every detail must be a cut-out shape you could pick up and move on a tabletop. Food is simplified graphic paper construction, NOT realistic food with paper grain. White dishes are layered cream paper ellipses, not rounded ceramic bowls. Human skin is flat peach/brown paper, restrained separate cheek patches, not smoothly airbrushed skin. Preserve European picture-book faces, small eyes, no black outlines, no anime. Actual transparent alpha outside cutouts, no ground shadows in gaps, no colored halo or background. No labels or text. LAST reference is the CONTENT/layout target only; keep all TEN food groups in the same 5 by 2 order. Top: vegetable soup; cutlet; chicken fillet; cottage cheese; syrniki. Bottom: glass of milk; glass of kefir; cooked beans; walnuts/hazelnuts; cucumber and slices. Rebuild the food entirely in flat cut-paper shapes. Cutlet: simple brown oval with 3 darker cut-paper patches, no realistic seared crust. Chicken: cream silhouette with 3 tan strips. Cottage cheese: several overlapping cream paper scallops, no real curds. Syrniki: flat yellow discs with a few ochre cutout patches. Nuts: few simple brown paper silhouettes, no realistic convoluted surfaces. Cucumber: green paper silhouette and flat cutout circular slices, no realistic bumps or wet flesh. Soup ingredients flat paper circles and squares on ochre ellipse. Keep recognizable food but aggressively remove photographic detail. Clean large gutters and outer margins. Wide sheet, transparent.
